definition: to take a quick secret look from hiding
description: A young woman in glasses and a beige cardigan sits at a long wooden table in a grand library, writing in an open textbook with a blue pen while other students work behind her. She piles more and more thick books on the table until the stacks form a wall taller than she is, and at the end she is hidden behind it, only her eyes showing as she looks out through a gap between the piles.

en.question: What is the hidden woman doing?

de.answer: Sie späht durch eine Lücke zwischen den Büchern.
phrases: den Kopf auf die Hand stützen
de.question: Was macht die versteckte Frau?

es.answer: Está mirando a escondidas por un hueco entre los libros.
phrases: mirar a escondidas por un hueco
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer escondida?

fr.answer: Elle regarde furtivement par un interstice entre les livres.
fr.question: Que fait la femme cachée ?
